_readme: dev environment settings for ensure-column-security-profile-members.ps1.
Only the keys that script actually reads are populated here: tenantId, auth,
dataverse.environmentUrl, dataverse.groupTeams and dataverse.columnSecurityProfiles.
environmentUrl/environmentId/tenantId are the same dev environment used by
dev-schema-settings.json, dev-scoring-settings.json, dev-auditing-settings.json etc.
entra.*, sharepoint and teams remain deliberately omitted — this file was created to
run one script, not as the full per-env settings file bind-roles-to-groups.ps1 and the
other provisioning scripts need; populate the rest before running any other
provisioning script against dev with this file.
dataverse.groupTeams (2026-09-18, IMP-0769) covers the 3 teams IMP-0734 actually
resolved live DEV names for — Admins, Service Accounts, Finance — with the same
securityRoles test-settings.json/prd-settings.json use (roles are matched BY NAME per
C-TECH-040 and do not vary by naming-convention drift). It deliberately has NO entry
for REV Trustees: IMP-0734's dev lookup never resolved a live DEV team name for that
persona (only Admins, Service Accounts and Finance were queried/confirmed), and no
other source in this repo has it either — see knowledge/technology/entra-id.md, which
states DEV confirmation is limited to those three. Do not invent one; the
no-trustee-in-column-security-profile gate does not need it (REV Trustees is not, and
must never be, a memberTeams entry of any columnSecurityProfile — that is the gate's
whole point). entraGroupObjectId values below are placeholder tokens in the same style
test/prd use, not resolved live ids — nothing in this repo has resolved DEV object ids
for these groups either.
memberTeams below (2026-09-15, IMP-0734) use the ACTUAL Dataverse group team names
confirmed live in this dev org via `teams?$select=name` — the Power Platform
admin center's group-team creation flow names the team after the Entra group's own
display name, not the shorter 'REV Finance' / 'REV Admins' style this repo's
settings/architecture assumed when written. 'REV-PP-GrantApplications-Finance-DEV'
carries a leading space in the live team name — reproduced here deliberately
because the lookup is an exact string match; flagged to the reviewer, not silently
trimmed.

_unresolved.why: The object id of the Entra security group backing the REV Admins group team in DEV. IMP-0734's live DEV lookup (2026-09-15) confirmed the Dataverse team NAME via `teams?$select=name`, but never resolved this group's Entra object id — no source in this repo has (see the _readme above). Resolve with GET /groups?$filter=displayName eq '<the Entra group backing REV-PP-GrantApplications-DEV>'&$select=id in a read-only Graph session. Never invented: a wrong group object id binds Dataverse security roles to the wrong set of people, which is a live access-control defect rather than a broken deploy (IMP-0011).
_unresolved.expiry_rationale: Four weeks, the same short lookup window test-settings.json used for its Entra id placeholders (IMP-0175) — DEV already exists and the team itself is already confirmed live, so only the object-id lookup remains.

_unresolved.why: The object id of the Entra security group backing the REV Service Accounts group team in DEV. Same gap and same resolution path as groupTeams[0].entraGroupObjectId above, declared separately because binding both teams to one group would silently give service accounts the admin role set.
_unresolved.expiry_rationale: Four weeks — same as groupTeams[0]; one Graph session against DEV clears all three entries in this block.

_unresolved.why: The object id of the Entra security group backing the REV Finance group team in DEV (wbs:8.2). Same gap and same resolution path as groupTeams[0].entraGroupObjectId above; the Finance team name itself carries the confirmed leading space (see the _readme above), but its Entra object id is unresolved in every source this repo has.
_unresolved.expiry_rationale: Four weeks — same as groupTeams[0]; one Graph session against DEV clears all three entries in this block.

groupTeams.name: REV-PP-GrantApplications-DEV
groupTeams._comment: Live DEV Dataverse team name confirmed 2026-09-15 (IMP-0734) via teams?$select=name — backs the 'REV Admins' persona (architecture/test/prd shorthand 'REV Admins'). entraGroupObjectId is a placeholder token, same style as test/prd; not resolved live.

groupTeams.name: REV-PP-GrantApplications-Service-DEV
groupTeams._comment: Live DEV Dataverse team name confirmed 2026-09-15 (IMP-0734) — backs the 'REV Service Accounts' persona.

groupTeams.name: REV-PP-GrantApplications-Finance-DEV
groupTeams._comment: Live DEV Dataverse team name confirmed 2026-09-15 (IMP-0734) — backs the 'REV Finance' persona (wbs:8.2). Carries a LEADING SPACE, confirmed live via the Dataverse Web API, reproduced deliberately because lookups are exact-match.

columnSecurityProfiles.name: REV_TrusteeRestricted
columnSecurityProfiles._comment: The profile ships in the managed solution; only its membership is provisioned. These two teams are the only principals that may read or write the Tier 4 secured columns (TAD §6, NFR-001). Team names below are this dev org's actual live names (IMP-0734), not the architecture's original 'REV Admins'/'REV Service Accounts' shorthand.

columnSecurityProfiles.name: REV_FinanceOnly
columnSecurityProfiles._comment: The profile ships in the managed solution; only its membership is provisioned. REV Service Accounts and, as of wbs:8.2 (2026-09-13), REV Finance are the only members — REV Admins remains deliberately excluded: the Admin role holds no table privilege on rev_bankaccount/rev_payment at all (TAD §6.2, NFR-002 separation of duties), so it must not be a profile member either, or a role misconfiguration would leak finance data through this profile as a second path. TAD §6.2.1 deliverable #5. Team names below are this dev org's actual live names (IMP-0734) — the Finance one carries a leading space, confirmed live via the Dataverse Web API, not a typo introduced here.
